36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
124699: One of the Abashiri Convicts who travels with Sugimoto's Group. Shiraishi is carefree and goofy, and prefers to sneak his way out of trouble. He is also rather immature.
124701: Asirpa is an Ainu girl who finds Sugimoto when he is attacked by a bear. Her father was one of the Ainu killed by the Japanese who stole the Ainu gold. Her Japanese name is Asuko Kochoube (小蝶辺明日子). From a young age, Asirpa was trained by her father to become a hunter.
124704: A demobilized soldier who survived the Russo-Japanese War in 1904. He served in the 1st Division of the Imperial Japanese Army and fought in the battle of 203 Hill.
125422: Hijikata is the vice-commander of the Shinsengumi and leader of his group. Despite being imprisoned for decades, he remains energetic and optimistic. Hijikata is very ambitious despite his old age and plans to take over Hokkaido and create his own country in defiance of Japan.
125426: Nagakura Shinpachi is a member of Hijikata's Group and regarded as the best swordsman in the Shinsengumi.
125438: Tetsuzou Nihei was a hunter and one of the Abashiri Convicts. He owns a dog named Ryu.
125439: Younger twin brother of Kouhei Nikaidou and a member of the 7th Division.
125440: Ogata is the former Superior Private of the 7th Division and a member of Hijikata's Group. Loyal only to himself, Ogata is pursuing the gold for his own reason, unknown to anyone.
125441: The Private First Class of the 7th Division and a Matagi of Tohoku. He seems to have a frail and low self-esteem, being shown to cry easily under heavy criticism.
125442: Leader of the 7th Division and one of the antagonists of the series. Tsurumi has an unpredictable, mildly histrionic and erratic behaviour. However, In the past, Tsurumi was normal and was even a brave Japanese officer who fought at the front during the Russo-Japanese war.
125443: One of the Abashiri Convicts. Ushiyama is a pragmatic and serious criminal. Aiming to steal the Ainu gold, Ushiyama is focused on his mission and always threads with prudence, regularly offering reasonable advice to Hijikata. He is also a womanizer.
127291: Kouhei Nikaidou is the Private First Class of the 7th Division and Youhei's older twin brother. Like his brother, he has a well accented face with a thin, pointed nose. His eyes have the rounded shape of black color equal to his hair cut very short.
127813: Corporal Tamai was a member of the 7th Division. He was in a group along with Genjirou Tanigaki, Noma, and Okada.
127815: Noma was a member of the 7th Division. He was in a group along with Genjirou Tanigaki, Tamai, and Okada.
128971: Koito Otonoshin is a Second Lieutenant of the 7th Division. Koito is a tall, dark-skinned man with dark hair. He has his side part slicked down to the left. His eyebrows are usually furrowed, with two larger sections towards the center, and furrow wrinkles up his forehead.
128972: A taxidermist who pledged allegiance to First Lieutenant Tsurumi. Edogai first appears as an affable and professional young taxidermist, before revealing his side interest in working with human skin and inventing high fashion.
129220: Wilk (Polish for wolf) was born in a Karafuto Ainu village, where his mother and maternal grandparents were born as well. He was the son of a Polish father and a Karafuto Ainu mother and raised as a Christian.
129247: An Ainu and an old friend of Asirpa's father.
129248: Osoma is Asirpa's cousin. She is a rambunctious, highly energetic child who has an affinity for games. Osoma seems to have taken a liking to Genjirou Tanigaki, often playing with him and crying when he had to leave the kotan.
129249: Inkarmat is a mysterious Ainu fortune-teller who meets Asirpa during her travels. She claims to know something important about Asirpa and her father.
129251: Kano Ienaga is the name assumed by one of the Abashiri Convicts.
129252: Former head jailer of Abashiri Prison and a member of Hijikata's Group.
129254: The grandmother of Asirpa through her maternal line. She can only speak Ainu and her husband was the most important man in the village.
129507: Cikapasi is a young Ainu boy that is from Asirpa's kotan.
131085: Toni Anji is an older man of a larger build. He has white hair with a round widow's peak and medium length facial hair around his chin. He has prominent cheek bones and wrinkles around his eyes and forehead.
131134: Kazuo Henmi was a serial killer and one of the Abashiri Convicts.
131135: Ryuu is Tetsuzou Nihei's bear-dog. Ryuu is an Ainu-ken, which is also called Hokkaido Dog. He has a typical spitz-dog appearance, such as small pricked ears, a curled tail resting on his back, and relatively short legs. He has urajiro colouring, and darker fur on his back.
131136: Hajime Tsukishima is a Sergeant under Tsurumi's command in the 7th Division.
131137: Retar is very large Ezo wolf with solid white fur and yellow eyes.
131302: Heiji Koito is a Rear Admiral of the Imperial Japanese Army.
131877: Usami is a Superior Private of the 7th Division serving directly under First Lieutenant Tsurumi.
131878: Narizou Arisaka is the Lieutenant General of the Imperial Japanese Army who is considered a genius arms designer. Due to his hearing loss from years of developing firearms, Arisaka and whoever he is talking to has to shout in order to have a conversation.
131879: Shirosuke Inudou is the warden of Abashiri Prison.
131880: Toraji was Saichi Sugimoto's best friend and Umeko's husband.
131881: Yamamoto is a barber in Barato.
131883: Kenkichi Aoyama was an Ani Matagi from the 1st Division.
131884: Kirawus is an Ainu man, currently working with Kadokura.
131885: Makanakkuru is Osoma's father and Asirpa's uncle through his sister.
131886: Kiyohiro Suzukawa is a con artist and one of the Abashiri Convicts.
131887: Maeyama was a member of the 7th Division.
132455: Shinpei Hidoro is the son of the Hidoro Family.
132456: Hidoro Boss was the true boss of the Hidoro Family. She was Tamotsu Hidoro's wife and Shinpei Hidoro's mother.
132457: Tamotsu Hidoro was the boss of the Hidoro Family.
132458: Umakichi Kusuda was a former member of the Hidoro Family.
132722: Vasily is a young, Russian sniper with sharp eyes, a furrowed brow and medium length wavy hair with long sideburns that covers his cheeks and chin. He wears a light ushanka hat, a light waist-belt coat, dark gloves and pants.
